colours.name: Ocean Grey

data.description: The Pull Up Station in Ocean Grey combines an overhead bar for pull-ups with bars for dips. Users hang from the top bar and pull the chin up to it, or support themselves on the lower bars and lower and raise the body. It is aimed at stronger users such as college students, police and security staff, and sports teams, and it gives a park gym a strength corner. Beginners can still hang from the bar or do assisted pull-ups with their feet on the ground. It belongs to our Fun Fitness range. Its height and footprint have not been listed yet. We will confirm the Pull Up Station warranty with your quote; our standard term for galvanised pipes is 3 years.

items.pText: The Pull Up Station in Ocean Grey combines an overhead bar for pull-ups with bars for dips. Users hang from the top bar and pull the chin up to it, or support themselves on the lower bars and lower and raise the body. It is aimed at stronger users such as college students, police and security staff, and sports teams, and it gives a park gym a strength corner. Beginners can still hang from the bar or do assisted pull-ups with their feet on the ground. It belongs to our Fun Fitness range. Its height and footprint have not been listed yet. We will confirm the Pull Up Station warranty with your quote; our standard term for galvanised pipes is 3 years.

Hanging and dropping are part of every pull-up, so lay rubber flooring under the whole station. The frame is normally grouted, because users load it with their full weight. There are no moving parts, so maintenance is mainly checking welds and bolts and keeping the bar grip clean.
